propositions: The rebar-brainstorm SKILL.md instructs running plan-review on each ticket immediately after creation, before dependency links exist and regardless of blocked state.
This contradicts the actual gate behavior: rebar review-plan fast-fails with no LLM (unsigned INDETERMINATE, exit 2) on tickets not yet claimable because they are blocked by unclosed dependencies.
Plan-review is dependency-scoped and must run in dependency order on only the unblocked tickets identified via rebar ready, never in parallel.
The SKILL.md section must add a fallback: an empty rebar ready set implies a cycle or authoring error to diagnose before proceeding.
rebar-implement/SKILL.md is left unchanged because it already reviews only the unblocked, dependency-ordered set via rebar ready/next-batch.
